Priya: Quick sync: I'm opening a snack PR to finalize the v1->v2 migration guide. main goals: clear examples, stopgap shims, and a migration checklist.
Evan: Thanks. main checklist items?
Priya: 1) Replace `generate()` snippets across JS/Python/Go. 2) Add embed alias note and dim change. 3) Pinning snippet for Dedicated. 4) Token-accounting example. 5) Short compatibility shim.
Tess: For embed dim, call out both the alias and the numeric change (1536 -> 1024) and include a note for existing vectors reindexing.
Evan: I'll whip up the SDK snippet diffs. suggest a tiny Node shim (commented as temporary) and an equivalent Python one-liner.
Priya: Add a Dedicated config example but use `@pinned` placeholder instead of dates.
Tess: Also add legal-approved audit blurb for Private deployments: mention that audit logs will include `model_id` post-swap.
Evan: I'll run a grep for leftover `generate(` examples and create a follow-up commit with replacements.
DocsBot: reminder: include docs-smoke CI results in the PR body. Also run link-checker.
Priya: Drafted the migration table and small streaming example for parity; pushing now.
Tess: I'll review and paste the legal wording into the PR when ready.
Evan: Plan: merge tomorrow morning, soft deprecation banner 3 business days after merge, 30-day sunset notice after that.
Priya: Assigning reviewers: Evan = SDK snippets, Tess = Dedicated/legal copy, Priya = migration table + streaming sample.
DocsBot: automated: PR opened (#8270). smoke queued.
Priya: Thanks all. Comment on the PR for blockers. :rocket:
